FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
NOTICE
No. ITC/446/2025
Subject:
1. Migration of the eFiling Portal from current eFiling Version 1.0 to
eFiling Version 3.0 as per the directions of the eCommittee, Supreme
Court of India.
2. Downtime of eFiling 3.0 services for District Judiciary.
With respect to the subject noted above it is informed to all the stakeholders
of the High Court and District Court that, as per the directions of the eCommittee,
Supreme Court of India the eFiling 1.0 platform is to be migrated to eFiling 3.0.
The said process would begin from 14/04/2025 and will continue till
17/04/2025. During the above mentioned period the eFiling 1.0 for High Court
and the eFiling 3.0 services for District Courts would be unavailable to all the
stakeholders.
All the stakeholders are requested to take note of the following points and
take necessary steps accordingly by 11/04/2025 03:00 PM,
1. To submit any cases that are in the compliance stage at High Court end in
eFiling 1.0
2. Only cases submitted and approved by the eFiling admin, subsequently
consumed in CIS, and CNR No. updated on the eFiling Portal will be
migrated.
3. Cases disapproved during this transition and draft stage cases will not be
moved to the eFiling 3.0, and advocates will need to re-register them.
After the the migration process is completed the eFiling 3.0 platform will be
available to the stakeholders of High Court and District Judiciary from
18/04/2025
Sd/-
Date: 11/04/2025 REGISTRAR (SCMS & ICT)
